intro: Our Honey dining chair is designed to bring warmth to any corner. With its cosy fabric seat, rich wood finish, and sturdy build, it makes every meal feel comforting, familiar, and filled with love.

features.title: Strong and steady
features.text: Solid rubberwood construction gives this chair stability for years of use.

features.title: Comfortable fabric seat
features.text: You’ll love how cosy this feels. Upholstered in soft fabric, it’s easy to clean and adds warmth and comfort to your space.

features.title: Designed to fit your space
features.text: Complete your dining space effortlessly—this chair pairs beautifully with our Amber and Onyx tables for a seamless look.

features.title: Ergonomic and cosy
features.text: Shaped for your comfort, the seat ensures every meal feels relaxed and enjoyable.

features.title: Warm cappuccino finish
features.text: The rich cappuccino finish adds a sophisticated touch, making your dining space feel warm and welcoming.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
